sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।यूपाक्षः सचिवो राज्ञः कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह ।। ६.६०.७२ ।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ saṁrabdhaṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।yūpākṣaḥ sacivo rājñaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha ।। 6.60.72 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! This kind of fear from humans has not arisen for us either from Daityas or Danavas."
